endpoints.description:
Score an antibody-antigen docking complex.

Runs the DeepRank-Ab EGNN pipeline: PDB processing, ESM-2 embeddings,
ANARCI CDR annotation, atom-level graph construction, MCL clustering,
and EGNN inference. Returns predicted DockQ scores as a CSV.

request_fields.name: heavy_chain_id
request_fields.description: PDB chain ID for the heavy chain.

request_fields.name: light_chain_id
request_fields.description: PDB chain ID for the light chain. Use '-' (or 'none'/'null') for nanobodies / VHH without a light chain.

request_fields.name: antigen_chain_id
request_fields.description: PDB chain ID for the antigen.

examples.title: score antibody-antigen complex
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/score -F input_pdb=@complex.pdb -F heavy_chain_id=H -F light_chain_id=L -F antigen_chain_id=A
examples.notes: Chains H (heavy), L (light), A (antigen) must exist in the PDB. Result is a CSV with predicted DockQ scores per model in the ensemble.

examples.title: score nanobody-antigen (no light chain)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/score -F input_pdb=@nanobody_complex.pdb -F heavy_chain_id=H -F light_chain_id=- -F antigen_chain_id=A
examples.notes: Use '-' for light_chain_id when scoring VHH / nanobody complexes.

endpoints.summary: Score an antibody-antigen docking complex as a single atomic task.
endpoints.description:
Score an antibody-antigen docking complex as a single atomic task.

Blocks until the DeepRank-Ab pipeline (PDB processing → ESM-2 embeddings →
ANARCI → graph → MCL → EGNN) completes.  Designed for FC Async Task Mode
invocation; the submit/poll interface is at POST /api/score.

request_fields.name: heavy_chain_id
request_fields.description: PDB chain ID for the heavy chain.

request_fields.name: light_chain_id
request_fields.description: PDB chain ID for the light chain. Use '-' (or 'none'/'null') for nanobodies / VHH without a light chain.

request_fields.name: antigen_chain_id
request_fields.description: PDB chain ID for the antigen.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

tool_outputs.score: output/<stem>-deeprank_ab_pred_<H><L>_<A>/<stem>-deeprank_ab_pred_<H><L>_<A>_predictions.csv — predicted DockQ scores sorted descending, with quality_flag column. Also: *_graph.hdf5 (atom-level graphs) and *_predictions.hdf5 (raw model outputs).
tool_outputs.note: Use GET /api/jobs/{id}/files to enumerate; download a single file via /api/jobs/{id}/file/{relpath} or zip the whole dir via /download.

input_uri_schemes.job://<id>/<file>: Re-use a file from a prior job on the same NAS.
Generic URL, including OSS signed URLs.

scoring_legend.predicted_dockq: 0–1, predicted DockQ score from the EGNN model.
scoring_legend.quality_flag: 'ok' = normal; 'low_HL_contacts' = fewer than 15 CA-CA contacts between VH and VL at 8 Å (suspicious); 'not_applicable' = nanobody / single-chain (no light chain).

model_info.architecture: EGNN (Equivariant Graph Neural Network), dual-branch with Gaussian RBF.
model_info.annotation: ANARCI IMGT numbering for CDR/FR/CONST region labels.

config_tips.light_chain_id: Use '-' for nanobodies / VHH that lack a light chain. The pipeline will skip light-chain annotation and contact checks.
config_tips.chain_ids: Chain IDs must match those in the input PDB file. Common convention: H=heavy, L=light, A=antigen.
